item.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: In-depth analysis of AI supply chain privacy issues with concrete examples and technical detail.

Researchers planted 2m digital tripwires in AI service requests to test data leakage. They found an ecosystem that leaked sensitive data. The experiment used AWS credentials and unique identifiers as 'canaries' to track leakage. The study revealed security breaches, prompt theft, and privacy violations in the AI supply chain.

Source: Ars Technica | Published: 2026-11-20 20:59 UTC

Original link: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/a-leaky-ai-supply-chain-is-exposing-secret-user-data-at-an-alarming-rate/

item.description:

Why it is here: Detailed and fascinating account of a rare astronomical event with clear scientific explanation.

In the Andromeda Galaxy, a massive star engulfed a smaller companion, a process called common envelope evolution. Astronomers, led by Columbia University's Viraj Karambelkar, observed this rare event from start to finish. The study, published in Nature, reveals the star's evolution over millions of years.

item.description:
